purpose: Independent static correctness, ownership and protocol review; no build, container, test or load executed

checks.finding: All nineteen source bytes match the immutable image proof; baseline application Goose, native API header, JSON primitive and io_uring implementation are unchanged.

Routing, JWT claim/error decisions, complete JSON parsing, SQL selection, live like counting, feed ordering/fallback and transaction loop remain in unchanged Goose app SHA1b9d5eaa... . No application SQL moved to C.

Defaults are 8192 KiB cache and zero mmap. strtoll checks ERANGE, complete consumption and bounds; cache1..524288 KiB and mmap0..4096 MiB fit signed64 arithmetic. Only formatted validated integers enter operational PRAGMA SQL. Invalid config fails startup and cleans the database handle.

WAL/NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON, exclusive locking, 4096-frame post-commit RESTART checkpoint and failed-commit rollback are unchanged. Goose commits before net_flush; failed commits still replace queued application responses with500 before send.
Only SQLite page-cache/mmap policy and reusable transport storage change. There is no application row, result, response or JWT cache. HMAC verification still occurs per authenticated request.

Status is normalized to100..599; fixed reason literals bound reason length, 3*sizeof(size_t) decimal storage fits every size_t value, header+body overflow is checked before allocation, and full headers/bodies are copied into connection-owned TX storage.

Per-batch activity time uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC refreshed at poll entry, after blocking wait and before flush after commit. JWT/creation clocks are unchanged. RX borrow, TX lifetime, partial writes, pipelining and commit gate are unchanged.

Independent synthetic exact-schema HTTP training uses the already reviewed flag-only SIGUSR1 helper; epoll_pwait atomically unmasks the signal and dumping occurs on the main thread at a poll boundary. Helper is uninstrumented and omitted from the production link; saved proof confirms no production training symbols.

The additional driver patch changes only the time.h include and time_us helper; source inventory differs only atsrc/wrk.c. Counter/histogram/timeout/event-loop source and request script remain unchanged. Both driver variants still count genuine >2-second durations in retained deterministic evidence. All remaining cases use one pinned corrected driver; historical stock results stay separate.

Protocol explicitly does not attribute every historical timeout to clocks, preserves the26-timeout sample without a >1ms monitor step, retains original errors, and says host scheduling noise remains. ae.c still uses wall time; this is not a complete event-loop clock rewrite.

The amendment preserves predeclared45-second confirmation, paired5% geometric mean and one-sided95% log-ratio lower-bound thresholds,9/10 individual5% wins, candidate error prohibition, bounded whole-round retries, p99 condition and immutable historical evidence.

protocol_evidence.timing_caveat: Filesystem timing corroborates the declared sequence; it is not a cryptographic timestamp.

review_result: No blocking correctness, ownership, API-regression or protocol guardrail issue found. Performance gains remain a separate measurement question.
